comparison.objective: Clip a spring-hinged pulse oximeter onto a manikin index finger while steadying the hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Opening a spring clip, insertion over soft-body geometry, and gentle stabilization rather than granular screening.
comparison.success_condition: Requires adequate fingertip insertion, jaw closure, display orientation, release, stillness, and no excessive hand displacement or dropped device; candidate requires mass separation and screen release.
comparison.reason: This tests gentle clip placement on a patient surrogate, not sorting. No material rubric detail is missing.
